text: Mitsuba Corporation, the electrical-components sponsor named on Honda HRC Castrol's sponsors page, publishes its major shareholders as at 31 March 2026: The Master Trust Bank of Japan (7.49%), The Bank of Yokohama (4.78%), a suppliers' shareholding association (4.41%), Honda Motor (3.62%) and others; no state or state fund appears among them.
short: Mitsuba's major holders are Japanese trust banks, regional banks and Honda (3.62%); no state.
